spec2def(winprint.dll winprint.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# winprint.dll is all Rust (winprint-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/winprint-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winprint-rust/src/winprint/main.rs)
# raw.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winprint-rust/src/winprint/raw.rs)
if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    set(WINPRINT_DESTINATION reactos/system32/spool/prtprocs/w32x86)
elseif(ARCH STREQUAL "amd64")
    set(WINPRINT_DESTINATION reactos/system32/spool/prtprocs/x64)
elseif(ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
    set(WINPRINT_DESTINATION reactos/system32/spool/prtprocs/arm64)
endif()
add_cargo_module(winprint winprint-cargo winprint.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE winprint-rust
    DESTINATION ${WINPRINT_DESTINATION}
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
